epic.title: Good to have — Pokédex and moves
epic.description: Extra Pokédex filters, collection markers, compare, special conditions, history and move tools.

features.title: Move and availability filters
tasks: Filter by move (incl. Elite TM / legacy)
Filter by availability: shiny released, in raids now

features.title: 'I own it' markers and collection tracker
tasks: Owned / missing markers and filter in the Pokédex
Completion by region and category (shiny, lucky, hundo, Shadow)

features.title: Compare 2–4 Pokémon
tasks: Compare screen: stats, max CP, moves, ranks side by side
Add to compare from lists and Pokémon pages

features.title: Special catch conditions (curated)
tasks: Curated conditions on the Pokémon page from AI findings approved by the admin

features.title: Changes over time (history backfill)
tasks: Backfill years of game-file history (stats, moves)
History section on the Pokémon page

features.title: Report wrong data
tasks: 'Report wrong data' on Pokémon and boss pages, feeding the review queue

features.title: Your copies on the Pokémon page
tasks: Your copies section with IVs, ranks and raid value

features.title: Power-up cost calculator
tasks: Stardust and candy from level A to B (incl. XL, Shadow, Purified, lucky)

features.title: Move history and Max moves
tasks: Move history (rebalances) on the move page
Max and G-Max move power by level

features.title: Move rankings per type and TM advice
tasks: Rankings: raids damage/energy per second, PvP per turn
TM advice: which of your Pokémon lack their best moves
